title: BuildCache@1 payload
description: A candidate-built artifact captured from a Gate's declared cache directory after its check Attempt on the head, carried Gate to Worker within one Round. EXPLICITLY UNSAFE: it was produced by candidate code under the trusted-local policy, carries no administrator approval and no credential-free guarantee, is admitted only under trusted_local and refused under the safe policy. It is never a Cache Snapshot. The closed capture layout admits regular files only through descriptor-relative no-follow traversal under entry, depth, path and byte limits, with two fixed modes and extended attributes and ACLs stripped. manifest_id names a source Manifest of file and executable entries whose bytes live in the CAS, so the cache re-materializes on a resumed Round like every other warm layer.
x-semantic-constraints: entries is at least 1 and at most limits.max_entries
the manifest names no symlink and every path satisfies the closed layout under limits

trust.description: The one trust a Build Cache can carry. It is stated in the payload so no reader mistakes the artifact for an administrator-approved Cache Snapshot.

gate_attempt_id.description: The common Task Attempt the Gate ran under, when the Task runtime executed it.

limits.description: The limits the capture applied: bytes, traversed filesystem entries (directories included), directory depth and portable path length.
